variants.about_this_item: Beaphar White Coat Shampoo for Dogs is a gentle, pH neutral shampoo specially formulated for white and light-haired dogs - delivering a gentle clean that helps keep coats looking bright. The mild formula cleanses without stripping away the natural oils, helping keep the coat comfortable and looking healthy. Enriched with Green Tea Extract and Aloe Vera to help leave your dog’s fur soft, smooth and freshly washed, it’s ideal to use as a regular shampoo for white dogs, helping lift everyday dirt that can make lighter coats look dull. Use it after muddy walks, for daily care or routine grooming to keep the coat feeling clean and looking cared for. With consistent use, it supports the coat’s natural tone so whites look clearer and light coats stay fresh. A specially formulated dog shampoo for white coats, this formula provides a clean rinse, a soft finish, and a bright, well-groomed appearance. The vegan formula contains 0% parabens and silicones. A practical white dog shampoo for regular grooming, leaving coats looking cleaner, feeling softer, and finishing with a fresh scent that suits everyday use on white and light-haired dogs.
variants.ingredient_information: Composition: Aqua, Sodium Laureth Sulfate, PEG-200 Hydrogenated Glyceryl Palmate, Glycereth-2 Cocoate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate, Sodium Chloride, Glycereth-7 Caprylate/Caprate, Parfum, Polysorbate 20, Lauryl Lactate, D-Limonene, Disodium EDTA, Glycol Distearate, Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate, Glycerin, Polyquaternium-7, Citric Acid, Glycine, Benzyl Alcohol, Triethylene Glycol, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract, Propylene Glycol, Sodium Benzoate, Sorbitan Laurate, Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract, Phenoxyethanol, Sodium Citrate, Methylchloroisothiazolinone, Methylisothiazolinone, Magnesium Chloride, Magnesium Nitrate, Potassium Sorbate, CI 42090, Sodium Sulfate
variants.feeding_instructions: Wet the coat with warm water, massage in gently until it lathers, then rinse thoroughly. Repeat as required and dry well afterwards
